name: Last Light of the Icarus
source:
You play as Arc Deluca, a retired military captain who left behind war and orders for something quieter. Alongside your spouse, Lior Deluca, and your ship’s enigmatic AI, Melinoë, you’ve set off into deep space.

You're not out for conquest, but for curiosity. To chase quiet skies. To be alone, together.

But buried truths have consequences.

[From [url=https://inkmeteor.itch.io/last-light-of-the-icarus]itch.io[/url]]
